title: Linen book cover: cloth weave, one swooping line (or a loop round the title) with a rocket glyph at its head, three stacked condensed caps lines
use: Book and report covers, manuals, data books, programme booklets.

swoop.note: one line from the lower left, or a loop round the title

swoop_ink.note: the line's ink on pale linen

publisher_mark.note: mark slot for the owner's logo, insignia or emblem file (PNG or SVG with alpha), placed with fit contain; 0.09 W x 0.06 H, centred at the foot; keep clear space of half its height; never drawn by the template

relations: Title block left aligned, three lines at 1.02 of the size, the widest line 0.62 W.
One band 0.045 W wide; the rocket glyph 0.1 W at the head of the dark line.
decoration: linen weave, the pale band, the dark line and the classic rocket glyph (line), or the loop with a hairline and a swept glyph (loop)

provenance.corpus: atomic-age kit (Halcyon Orbital Lines): our own original world in the atomic-age grammar, examples/atomic-age-kit
provenance.experiment: styles/atomic-age/style.json provenance (owner-supplied mood board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: k-means palette (6 clusters, OKLab-free RGB on a 160 px reduction), light and dark shares, visual-weight centre and proportions read on the board's linen panel
measured: band width about 0.045 W; the rocket glyph about 0.1 W
